data.gender_notes: Faseeha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who helps and heals, especially in spiritual matters. Derived from the Arabic root 'f-s-h', meaning to relieve, to provide succor, to help, and to heal. The name Faseeha carries the meaning “Healer, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Faseeha usually hope their child will grow to embody healer, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of compassion and healing in the Islamic tradition.
data.etymology: Faseeha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Healer, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faseeha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
